title: Inheritance Strategies
description: Learn TPH, TPT, and TPC inheritance mapping strategies.
longDescription: This module covers the three inheritance mapping strategies in EF Core: Table per Hierarchy (TPH), Table per Type (TPT), and Table per Concrete Type (TPC).
whatYouLearn: Understand inheritance mapping strategies in EF Core
Configure TPT with base and derived tables
Use TPC for concrete type tables
